app.name: SCMT
app.summary: Simple Customizable Media Tile: the song, progress, volume and buttons of a media player.
app.opt_action_hint: What this tile does when you tap it.
app.opt_cover_hint: Shows the cover at the left or at the right of the text, from two cells wide, if the screen can show pictures.
app.opt_cover_url_hint: Address of a picture in Home Assistant, for example a template image with the player's cover: /api/image_proxy/image.scmt_cover?v={v}. Use it when the player's own cover is refused. {v} becomes a number that changes with every track. Files under /local/ do not work with Tessera 0.4.88. Leave empty to use the player's picture.
app.opt_buttons_hint: Under the title: previous, play/pause and next; quieter, mute and louder; or both. Needs a tile of two rows or more. With the volume buttons, a tap on a volume display mutes too.
app.opt_timeline_hint: How far the song has played: as a bar, as the time, or both. Needs a player that reports the position.
app.opt_voldisp_hint: Shows the volume at the title's right.
app.opt_overlay_hint: A half see-through display over the whole tile: for three seconds when the volume changes (number and speaker), and/or while the player is paused (pause sign).
app.opt_text_size_hint: How large title, artist and album are. A title that is too wide runs as a marquee; on a low tile the text gets smaller.
app.opt_volbar_hint: An upright bar along the right edge of the tile; a tap on it sets the volume to that height. Needs a tile of two columns or more.
app.opt_album_hint: The album as a third line, when the tile is high enough.
app.opt_bpm_hint: The tempo of the music as a line under the artist, for example "138 BPM", from the tempo sensor chosen for the screen in Tessera (Plugins). After a new track it shows once the sensor has the new tempo.
app.input_bpm_hint: A sensor with the tempo of the music in BPM, for the tile option "Tempo", for example the one HASS.Agent makes from BPM2SCMT. Leave it empty if you do not use it.
app.opt_barh_hint: In pixels, 2 to 16. Needs the bar.
app.opt_text_pos_hint: Where title and artist (and the album) stand beside the cover: at the top, in the middle or at the bottom, lined up with the cover's edges.
